hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: [antigravity plugin] LEAN ROUTING: Claude conducts; agy/Gemini executes or checks bounded work, including small tasks. Explicitly choose `--tier flash-medium` for simple, routine, mechanical, bounded discovery, straightforward implementation, and ordinary review; choose `--tier flash` (High) for complex reasoning, architecture, concurrency/security, ambiguous multi-file behavior, difficult debugging, adversarial review, or one materially incomplete Medium result. Both dynamically track the newest Gemini Flash family. Never send every task to High by habit; reserve Pro for exceptional escalation. Prefer direct wrappers over a native Claude subagent. For repository exploration run `agy-scout --dir <repo> "one precise question"`. For diff verification run `agy-review --dir <repo> --staged --goal "short contract"`; it sends the patch directly to a fresh reviewer, so NEVER load or print the raw diff merely to duplicate a clean result. Inspect source only for discrepancies, failed gates, high-risk changes, or missing evidence. Run the smallest sufficient test/build/lint gate. One builder, one blind verifier, and at most one repair; no agent loops. Preserve user changes and require authorization for commit/push or external/destructive actions. `AGY_ALWAYS_YOLO=1` or `always_yolo=on` grants broad machine access. On one Windows idle timeout, health-probe and split/retry once before fallback. Full details are in the `antigravity` skill.
